A receipt declaration knowledge ships

Source: R/receipt.R
knw_receipt_keys.Rd

Each output knowledge writes a provenance receipt for (#154) declares, as data beside its writer, what only knowledge knows about it: which inputs, run settings and config files are its recipe, which tables are fingerprinted and with what tolerance, which summary values it reports, and which differences only a record. crate reads the declaration (crate::crt_receipt_keys()); knowledge never re-implements the hashing. The declarations are inst/receipt/<output>.yaml.

Usage

knw_receipt_keys(output)

Arguments

output

character(1): "grade" (a grade table, knw_grade_receipt_write()), "evidence" (an evidence build, knw_evidence_receipt_write(), #160), "thresholds", "habitat_grade" or "fdis" (the published sets, knw_publish()).

Value

A crt_receipt_keys list, as crate::crt_receipt_keys() returns.

Examples

k <- knw_receipt_keys("grade")
k$inputs
#> [1] "link_build" "flow"       "evidence"  
k$tolerance$summary
#> $km_graded
#> [1] 0.001
#> 
#> $grade_sum
#> [1] 0.001
#>
